title: if expressions in the compact form
purpose: `if c: a else: b` is the block if spelled with colons: one expression per branch, only the chosen one runs, else goes to the nearest if, and a branch fallback takes parentheses (#921).

provenance.expected_basis: grammar: if_expr = "if" expr (block "else" (if_expr | block) | ":" expr "else" ":" expr); spec 8.11: the compact form is the block form.
